lines.english: "Hey, Haruki-kun."
"I'll always keep you warm from now on…"
"I won't let your heart or your body feel this pain again. The pain, sadness, and agony of losing Kazusa… I'll melt it all away for you."
"Stop this, Setsuna…"
"After all, I was the reason why you had to suffer so much, Haruki-kun. That's why you don't have to feel reserved at all and use me as you see fit."
"That won't solve anything. The pain, sadness and agony… wouldn't you only be bearing all of that in my stead?"
"I don't mind bearing it for you. Let me bear it in your place. I wouldn't mind acting as someone's substitute for you."
"That won't do…"
"I'll be Kazusa's substitute and support you. I'll be your substitute and bear everything in your place."
"Setsuna…!"
"I'll… give you warmth, okay?"
"That's great! Takahiro-kun made it, huh!"
"Yeah, we just went to check the results together. He got into Public Policy because there was a vacant spot…"
"Well, even if he's just filling a vacant spot, he still got in fair and square. Congratulations."
"Thank you. …It's pretty much required to have a recommendation to get in here. He was goofing off until summer."
"I see, so the cherry blossoms are in full bloom for the Ogiso family as well…"
"Yeah… winter's almost over."
"Ah, speaking of which, your family is celebrating tonight, right? I was thinking of inviting you to dinner."
"Yeah, I'm sorry. Let's save that for next time."
"It's fine, since it's a celebration. As long as you're having fun, Setsuna, it's okay."
"I was just thinking that you should find some time to enjoy yourself, even if a little, if you're feeling hurt, Setsuna."
"As long as you're having fun, I'm not exactly needed. If you need a shoulder to cry on, or you want someone to talk to… I'll always be here, alright?"
"Thank you."
"…I know I've asked you this already, but are you really okay with this?"
"…Yeah."
"If you really want to solve this on your own, then I won't say any more."
"Thank you for what you've done for me up until now. Please thank Takeya-kun for me as well."
"So, um… what are you planning to do?"
"About what?"
"About those three years behind you two?"
"Three years, huh. Looking back on it now, I suppose we share an inseparable bond, though not necessarily in a good way."
"If only the two of you were close enough to just be friendly."
"Like you and Takeya, Io?"
"That bond's as good as rotten and gone without a trace after these six years, though."
"Hehe…"
"…You can put an end to this, right?"
"Yeah, I will."
"When?"
"When winter… comes to an end."
"Hey, Haruki-kun…"
"Have you… found someone you like? Have you… moved on, somewhat?"
"T-That was…"
"If you did, could you introduce me this time? Don't worry, I won't say anything weird… I won't do anything that could cause you trouble."
"Hey, please don't worry, Haruki-kun. I absolutely won't hate you, no matter what happens."
"Setsuna…"
"That's why you don't need to hide it. You don't have to feel guilty about me either…"
"Why…? After all, I…"
"Our relationship won't be ruined by this."
"Eh…"
"…Or am I… the only one who thinks that way?"
"In these three years, many things happened. Our relationship almost fell apart numerous times."
"…I suppose so."
"But right now, we can still be together like this. As lovers, as friends, as a friend's friend. We're still connected to each other."
"Yeah."
"That's why things will be okay from now on as well. That's what I believe."
"…Can I believe that as well?"
"If you're willing to believe that, I'll never betray you, you know?"
"Yeah…"
"That's why, Haruki-kun… I'll leave you under her care for now."
"But… we'll always be together from now on, okay?"
"Congratulations on advancing to the next grade."
"Coming from you…"

I finished my supplementary exams and turned in all of my late papers. It's pretty much set in stone that I'll be advancing into my fourth year. At long last, I can properly receive this toast from the bottom of my heart.
"It's finally spring break for us."
"Even though we call it spring break, it still feels like winter, though."
"Nah, starting March, it'll start getting warmer. That's not too far from now."
"Is that so… So the winter will come to an end…"
As much as I can say it's about to end, the temperature yesterday just set a new record in terms of coldness.

The results were posted today as well, and a portion of the students probably didn't feel like it was spring. I wonder how many days it would take before everyone can feel the warmth of the sunlight again?
"It's gonna be busy now that we're fourth-year students. Finding a job, writing a graduation thesis, making memories with girls."
"Don't you do that last one every year?"
"But the fourth year in university is like a season where the journey begins. …It's the year where we don't want any regrets, right?"
"I'm sure you said the same thing three years ago…"
"I see, you still remember that."
"I see you haven't changed at all after all these years. It's because you're always so stubborn that Io…"
"Well then, do you remember what else I said back then?"
"You get that, Haruki? There's a future for you and Setsuna-chan, you know?"
"I see you haven't changed at all after all these years. You're still dragging the past with you…"
"…I don't remember that."
I do remember.
"You really didn't have to say that so unconfidently. I can feel the guilt rising in you. Don't say I'm wrong."
My heart was wavering about what I was supposed to do back then, but I ended up choosing a reality that would turn out to be the most painful for everyone.
I made a choice that anyone would consider a mistake, and I regret it.
But even now, even when I'm confronted with the same choices as back then, I don't have the confidence to say that I'll make the correct choice this time.
…I still haven't found the correct answer for that situation to this day.
"Haruki."
"Hm?"
"I made a promise with Io."
"About what?"
"No matter what decision you and Setsuna-chan make, our friendship will continue with you two."
"Ah…"
"We won't exclude anyone from this group. No matter what you guys say, the four of us will continue to be together."
"Takeya…"
"That's why you have to face reality. And one day, let it be something we can just laugh about."
No… Perhaps there was never a correct choice in the first place.
"It's your decision after this. There's nothing else I can help you with, but I'll accept the result no matter what."
"…Thank you. And I'm sorry."
Perhaps the only choice I have is… the painful, sorrowful and agonizing decision of having to hurt someone and having to cause another to be hurt even more deeply.
I don't know if there's any happiness at the end of the tunnel for such a decision, but I have to make my choice within the limited time I have left.
"It's fine. In exchange, you must promise not to avoid us from now on, got it?"
"…Yeah."
I know that it will only hurt everyone, but even so, I'm doing this to take back even the slightest happiness that I can.
"You love Haruki-kun, don't you?"
"I don't see anything in a guy like him. I was simply using him from head to toe."
"And so, with those feelings of guilt, you can't move on anymore, right? Ah… yeah, I understand. I understand completely."
"Could you stop deciding things by yourself on a whim? Getting hit in the face once or twice would be much better compared to…"
"But I'm sorryーI also can't come to hate you. Thank you, Shouko-san. Despite all this, I was still saved by you."
"Why is everyone just…!"
"Thank you for helping him. Thank you for playing the role of me."
"…What are you saying?"
"Thank you for keeping him warm in my place."
"Like I said, during that time, I didn't go there in your place, Ogiso-san…"
"But that's what Haruki-kun believed. Because I made him a promise. I promised that I would take Kazusa's place and support him."
"…He probably forgot about it long ago."
"But what I did was the exact opposite. I even forced my feelings onto him and ended up hurting him…"
"Well, I suppose that just made things easier. You made it so that Haruki was completely obsessed with me."
"Yeah, that's fine, Chiaki-san. You played my role perfectly."
"Like I said, it's not like that. My acting has just begun…"
"Can you please continue from now on? I couldn't do anything for him. Can you please take my place?"
"I was still being myself back then…"
"Yourself…? And who would that be?"
"It's fine, Chiaki-san. You don't have to think too much, you can just become me…"
"That's the only choice somebody as hollow as you has."
"That's something I came up with after putting my life on the line! The woman that Haruki needs, a woman who's not feminine, the exact opposite of Ogiso Setsuna…"
"You don't need to think too much… Haruki-kun will definitely return to my side."
"Wha…"
"No one's capable of overthrowing the three years we shared together. With the exception of Kazusa, that is."
"That's why for now… I'll give you a push on the back. I hope that you'll protect Haruki-kun somehow."
"…Until spring arrives, okay?"
"You're so annoying!"
"Huff, huff, haaa… ugh, uggh…"
"Ah…"
"Sorry for interrupting you."
"Didn't I say that I didn't want to meet anyone before I'm done with this?"
"Can you please give me what you've already finished? I know the story is already finished in your head, but I still need to make arrangements on my side."
"When did it become five acts…? Wasn't it supposed to end within three acts?"
"As I thought, the story just wouldn't feel complete unless I add what happened three years after that."
"How many hours are you planning to make this play last for?"
"…I won't leave anything out, you know?"
"I'm fine with that, but can your stamina keep up, princess? You're not in the best shape, now, are you?"
"That's… not quite it."
"While I'm at it, it seems you're stuck in a rut again. I'll clean up for you afterward, so don't go touching the broken pieces left over there, okay?"
"Yukine is pissing me off… she's mocking me."
"How can a goddess be mocked by the very human she created?"

"The goddess created Hatsushiba Yukine in the image of Ogiso Setsuna. But all at once, Yukine stopped listening to the goddess' will. She started loving Nishimura Kazuki of her own accord and tried to have him all to herself…"
"Aren't you usually capable of perfectly becoming Yukine herself? Why can't you sync up with her this time? …Is she not a character you created yourself?"
"Because I couldn't understand the model's feelings. Not to mention, well…"
"Was it jealousy?"
"…Was it?"
"That's the most likely conclusion I'm drawing, applying your own way of thinking, princess."
"Am I really that much of a deviant?"
"Falling in love with a man, kissing, having sex. To you, those are just like becoming the savior of the world, becoming a demon and killing people… or becoming the Grateful Crane, right?"
"Well, what's wrong with that?"
"…In other words, it's all just an act. You're just full of yourself. No matter who you deal with, you only see them for the role they're playing."
"Mm～"
"That's why social experience, research and communicating with others are all crucial feedback for an actress."
"Here comes some more nonsensical drivel from you again, President…"
"In the end, you've made great strides as an actress, but you have failed to grow as a person."
"Look at how big my breasts are already, though?"
"Your heart is still that of a child's. And only in the sense that you're cruel and enjoy toying with other people."
"Hmm…"
"Not that I think that it's necessarily a bad thing. I created this troupe because I was fascinated by that side of yours, princess."
"I'm not a puppet for you to tug at my strings, President…"
"As if I ever had even the slightest control over you! I'd actually appreciate it if you would listen to me for once. My doctor told me that I'm seriously going to get an ulcer at this rate."
"Hmmmm…"
"It's just…"
"What?"
"Just this once, I feel like I see a sign of that changing. I've never witnessed anything like this before…"
"So you really think it's jealousy? You think I'm jealous of Yukine?"
"If you still have to ask, then…"
"If that's the case, then there's only one explanation."
"The feminine side of our princess has finally awakened…?"
"Nope, I've already leapt over that. My maternal instinct is what's awakened."
"…Huh?"
"I think I'm pregnant. …With Haruki's child."
